title: Resolve supported Auto lenses from source EXIF during Lightroom import
notes: A fresh Lightroom folder import used to store Auto lens correction with no parameters, because resolution ran before the sidecar had source EXIF and opening did not try again. Supported lenses now resolve with the same native Auto path before the first imported preview or export. Imported enable flags and amounts stay as imported. A lens the database does not support stays without a maker, model, or parameter object. A distortion-only profile does not claim vignetting.
